title: SOCRadar Featured in Microsoft’s Ignite 2026 Sentinel Connectors
content_md: Microsoft has published its Microsoft Ignite 2026 announcement of new and enhanced Microsoft Sentinel connectors, and SOCRadar is part of it. The post features the SOCRadar Alerts Azure Sentinel Directional Solution among the partner connectors added to an ecosystem of more than 500 Microsoft Sentinel connectors. We thank Microsoft’s App Assure team for the partnership. Below is what the connector brings to the SOC, and how SOCRadar’s other Microsoft integrations fit around it. How the connector appears in Microsoft’s announcement: SOCRadar Threat Intelligence for Microsoft Sentinel enriches security operations by bringing prioritized, context-rich alerts directly into Microsoft Sentinel. Covering SOCRadar’s Extended Threat Intelligence capabilities, including Brand Protection, External Attack Surface Management (ASM), Third-Party Findings, and other security modules, the integration helps organizations monitor external threats and manage investigations within their existing SOC workflows. Bidirectional synchronization also helps keep incident status, severity, and comments aligned between Microsoft Sentinel and SOCRadar.
